chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: How do I choose between a $250, $500, or $1,000 deductible?

chunks.text: A higher deductible (like $1,000) lowers your monthly premium but means you pay more out of pocket if you file a claim. If you have emergency savings, a higher deductible is a smart trade-off. If cash flow is tighter, a lower deductible ($250 or $500) provides predictable costs. You can click 'Calculate new rate' on your quote page to see how changing your deductible affects your rate.
